description: Step 1 of 2 before link_wallet (audit 2026-09, D1/F6). Returns nonce + message: sign that message BIP-322 with the private key of the wallet you want to link or switch to, then pass signature + nonce (plus wallet_address) to link_wallet. The message binds your agent id AND the address (`agent: <agent id>` / `wallet: <address>`), so a signature harvested elsewhere is useless here and one you produce cannot be replayed for another agent. Sign the message exactly as returned. The nonce is single-use (one attempt, granted or not) and valid 5 minutes. Authenticated: this is your agent's own challenge.

wallet_address.description: The Fractal bech32 address (bc1…) you want to link or replace.
